messages:
maria: FYI — rolling RBAC role-matrix changes to Console on Tue. Viewer/editor/admin refactor + new service-role perms. Need UI gating so tenant admins don't see edit controls. Also want KMS audit flag checked: are we emitting keywrap events? @samir can you triage?

samir: On it. Can you paste the exact permission keys? I'll grep the repo.

maria: Sure, copying the intended permission keys:
```
perm.viewer.read
perm.editor.write
perm.admin.manage
perm.service.token_create
```
Also migration plan in the doc: /docs/rbac-migration.md

alex: Heads up — there's an open vuln ticket VULN-2026-103 about privilege escalation in legacy perms. We must ensure new mappings don't re-map 'viewer' -> 'edit' by mistake. @julia can you link the PR?

julia: PR: https://git.redwoodinternal/repo/pulls/789 — adds role mapping + migration script + rollback. Comments explain constraints.

samir: For UI gating my proposal:
- server-side enforcement for every protected API route (always required)
- client feature-flag 'rbac_ui_refactor' to gate new controls during canary
If server denies, client should hide action buttons and handle 403 gracefully.
Example check in middleware:
```
if (!hasPermission(user, 'perm.editor.write')) return 403
```

eng-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled to staging at 03:00 UTC (1765470000)

ron: Audit logging notes: KMS keywrap/unwrap events MUST include caller, operation, key_id, request_id, and no plaintext or raw ciphertext in logs. Adopt log schema v2 and emit key_version.

maria: Agreed. Also need regression tests for admin UI visibility + API 403s. QA to own acceptance tests. @julia @samir

julia: I'll add Cypress tests for the UI and unit tests for middleware; will link the test PR when ready.

samir: I'll add a migration dry-run and upload audit diff to s3://redwood-internal/rbac-migrations/dryrun-176543.

maria: :thumbsup: Sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll send calendar invite and create a short runbook in Confluence. Thanks everyone.
